Pakistani spies infiltrated Army-CAPF WhatsApp groups, Navy dockyard

Pakistani intelligence operatives infiltrated at least 13-14 WhatsApp groups used by the Army and Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF), where they viewed chats and documents. Separately, a trainee at a naval dockyard is accused of recording 90 videos and participating in group calls with Pakistani agents. Investigations are ongoing.
